notes: Check the cost and deadlines with the program before you apply.
name: Washington Journalism and Media Conference (WJMC)
what_you_do: A week-long conference where you live on campus. You learn by doing with working journalists, world news outlets and Washington insiders. Students live in GMU dorms and earn general elective credit.
who_can_apply: Highly engaged high school students. GMU's camps list says rising 11th and 12th graders. Students can register or be nominated.
pay_detail: Tuition not stated on the pages read. A scholarship is offered.
duration: One week (July 11 to 16 or July 18 to 23, 2027)
deadline_text: 2027 session dates are listed. The page shows a scholarship deadline of Feb 16, 2026 (looks left over from last cycle). No general deadline posted.
how_to_apply: Use the Register page (wjmc.gmu.edu/register). Scholarship details are at wjmc.gmu.edu/scholarships/. A Nominate link is also on the site.
